turns.assessment: The outage is a directional, multi-channel optical failure rather than a client-port or OTN-switch fault. Channels arriving at S19 from S06 remain visible, while many channels leaving S19 toward S18 disappear together and then cause LOS downstream at S18/S17/S24. Stable S19–S18 amplifier telemetry argues against a fibre cut, pulled OMS patch, or pump failure; the boundary is the S19 ROADM, consistent with failure of the WSS input port handling the affected arriving degree.

proposals.rationale: A failed WSS input port at roadm.S19 can simultaneously block all affected channels arriving on one degree while leaving channels on other degrees and aggregate line-amplifier telemetry unaffected. This matches the abrupt common onset, healthy upstream observations into S19, and channel losses downstream from S19.

clarify.assessment: The loss propagates from S19 toward S18 and then onward to S17/S24, while optical monitoring on the S06→S19 line remains unchanged up to S19. That localizes the block to the S19 WSS input receiving the otherwise healthy S06→S19 degree, rather than the S18, S10, or S21 input ports.
